userDecision: 2026-11-07: "不需要收费验证啊，目前我这个是规划开源项目" (M4 becomes open-source release v0.1); "先看一眼计划，把计划定稿，然后你直接建公开仓库，但是先不放代码进去" (overall plan final: wave 12 widened, lighter light gates, skip remembers the kind at the location); "开始写第十二波"

tasks.allowedFfiNote: desktop-wave-check does not enforce FFI; SERVICE-M35 section 2 allows only SHQueryRecycleBinW as a new system function, checked by hand at acceptance
tasks.realDataPermission: read-only metadata per ADR-018; clean disabled in the real smoke
tasks.title: 服务：整组整行跳过、诊断信息、首页去嵌套与几处收尾
tasks.purpose: skip_unit_add (group, template, folder kinds; settings v4; card menu and row skip keys), diagnostics_get, conclusion plan without nested double count, drawer and plan agree on unfinished items, trends state new, clean record kept on journal failure and quarantine error, refresh order
tasks.modelHint: Service: W12 sections 1, 2.2, 4; executor interface already in the base; two pre-listed old assertions; medium gate.
tasks.hint: Service, batch 2 on main after N3, N5, N6; section 1.8 nested-item dedupe is nc3; line numbers rechecked on this base.
tasks.dispatchEvidence: user 2026-11-07 after the paste lines: "界面单是opus，其他的都是sol"

addenda.resumeNote: no worker commit existed when the addendum was forwarded (22:13 JST); the first, 846ca073, is 22:23 and includes it
addenda.reason: W12-P1 independent review: the service kept running quarantine batches after the executor returned a report with journal_error
addenda.controllerMutationPlanned: clean_start keeps running the remaining batches after journal_error

controllerReview.summary: medium gate: audit 0 problems after the controller added the missing addendum resumeFromCommit (base 6fd29e34, no worker commit existed when the addendum went out); fresh tree lock, check, real and test finals; three ticket controls replayed and caught; controller mutations c1 (keep running quarantine batches after journal_error, addendum 01), c2 (folder skips case-sensitive) and c3 (diagnostics carry the data folder) all caught at their intended assertions; independent review found no high issue and one medium carried over; implementation commits 846ca073 and 89b79d4f (finals on the latter)

carryOverLater: medium: a leak cluster skipped from its card keeps its clue while any member is not cleanable (too recent, or kept as newest for <h> templates), because the clue check counts only members that were cleanable and skipped; w12_skip_rows ages every member to 20 days, so no test sees it

a quarantine batch that returns Err(Journal) after earlier work becomes a failed group, not a journal stop: later batches still go to the executor, journal_note_zh stays null and diagnostics last_clean.journal_error is false (safe: the executor writes intent before acting)

"nothing done yet" is judged by moved bytes: if earlier batches moved only 0-byte items, a later Err(Journal) returns JOURNAL_MESSAGE and the clean record is not saved (the quarantine records still are)
a quarantine id is reserved in memory and written into the stored report for batches that never run (no folder, no save_moves)
journal_note_zh can read "后面的 0 项没有清" when the failure is on the last item; with W12-P1 the m35_clean_split journal fixture produces exactly this
quarantine failure notes carry English executor errors (journal write failed, filesystem operation failed) in the Chinese UI
when every batch is unrun or failed the view still writes a quarantined block with item_count 0; unrun batches do not advance the progress observer
skip_unit_add with no scan returns not_found rather than stale or invalid
template skips dedupe case-insensitively but match the template exactly (contract wording)

tests weaker than named: template and folder fixtures share one template and parent, so a unit skip that matched the whole group would pass; the journal-stop test injects a quarantine report with journal_error and nothing moved, which W12-P1 never produces; SERVICE_W12_DIAG runs only with last_clean null; the 4.2 drawer assertion passes if the row is absent
